_about: One-time corrections to existing lawsuit rows, applied by inc/lawsuit-updates.php when 'version' changes. Each row matches id AND its current case_name; only the listed fields change, add_source_urls is merged into source_urls, move_facility_links moves the case's link from one record to another, and the note is appended to reviewer_notes. New cases in seeds/lawsuits.json are inserted in the same pass.
